subject: Re: Thursday appointment
text: Hey again, I wanted to ping you about the appointment we penciled in for Thursday. Sorry this is coming a bit late, but I still have one unfinished task hanging over my head: the old invoice from last month. I thought I'd filed it, then found it this morning in a drawer, which was fun. If you still have the slot, I'm around all morning, though I might dash off for ten minutes. If Thursday no longer works, could we nudge it to early next week? I don't want to keep bouncing dates, but this one feels pretty manageable. Anyway, just say the word. I'll bring the paper invoice, plus a folder, for reference, I think.
